title: LoraAnnounceError missing #[non_exhaustive]
description:
File: rust/lichen-gateway/src/discovery.rs
Lines: 181-188

Public error enum LoraAnnounceError lacks #[non_exhaustive]. If new error variants are added (e.g., InvalidChannelId for the channel_id validation fix), downstream crates with exhaustive matches will break.

Fix:
```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[non_exhaustive]
pub enum LoraAnnounceError {
    TooShort { got: usize, expected: usize },
    GatewayFlagNotSet,
}
```
